Create ONE beautiful premium minimalist 3D pictogram for a polished mobile wallet add menu. This is a small sculptural product illustration with simple geometry, rendered like an expensive industrial-design maquette. VERY SIMPLIFIED ICON: a few broad surfaces, rounded sculpted corners, only the essential large identifying features. Clear silhouette at 64px. Smooth untextured satin ceramic surfaces. Square composition; object centered and fits completely inside the canvas with 15% transparent margin on every side.
Family style: orthographic three-quarter camera, front facing lower-left and side receding upper-right, slightly elevated 15 degrees; porcelain ivory and midnight petrol-teal, brushed-silver accents, dark smooth glass if needed. Upper-left large soft studio light, gentle fill and refined soft ambient occlusion. Restrained quiet palette and tasteful material depth. Clean premium edge highlights. Transparent background, no scenery or ground plane, very subtle short soft contact shadow.
Strict exclusions: NO photorealistic mechanical detail, no realistic vehicle surface paneling, no seats visible, no realistic wheel suspension, no intricate wheels, no photographic textures, no toy plastic gloss, no logos, text, numbers, labels, QR, watermark, people or decorations. One isolated icon only.
Subject: ONE compact modern RAILWAY TRAIN locomotive resting on two short parallel brushed-silver rail tracks connected by THREE wide simple charcoal sleepers. The rails are an essential large visible identifying feature under the train wheels. Compact blunt rounded locomotive nose, broad dark front windshield, two small warm headlights and a central dark coupler on the lower front. Ivory upper body and midnight petrol-teal lower body, only two broad side windows. Solid silver flanged rail wheels, no black rubber tires. Front face is tall and blunt rather than a long pointed nose, clearly a TRAIN, visibly different from a road coach or van. Few smooth broad sculptural shapes, expensive satin ceramic maquette, no intricate vehicle detail.
